A Twitch channel's chat and announcements.

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own Twitch account in the Gateway, once, and every app that asks uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/twitch/callback
```

Helix also wants the public client id as a Client-Id header on every call. Not yet tried against a live connect.

1. Open [dev.twitch.tv](https://dev.twitch.tv/console/apps) and create an OAuth app (also called a client or an integration).
2. Add the redirect URI above.
3. Copy the client ID and client secret. The secret is often shown only once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add twitch
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  twitch: { access: "read", scopes: ["chat.read"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Apps ask for these scope sets:

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chat.read` | Chat (read) | `user:read:chat` |
| `chat.write` | Chat messages and announcements | `user:read:chat`, `user:write:chat`, `moderator:manage:announcements` |

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show twitch` shows the client as set. Then open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect Twitch**.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Twitch).
